entities.name: Query FtsH protease
observations: 679 aa; calculated molecular mass 73.46 kDa, theoretical pI 5.03, and predicted net charge at pH 7 of about -21.6.
N-terminal hydrophobic segment and a second hydrophobic segment around residues 100–130 indicate membrane anchoring, with the large C-terminal region cytosolic.
Pfam matches: FtsH_ext at residues 9–82, AAA/AAA_5 ATPase domains at approximately 198–331, AAA lid at 354–392, and Peptidase_M41 at 413–602.
Closest reviewed homologs are FtsH proteins with 57.7–69.8% identity and about 91–93% query coverage.
Sequence supports an ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease involved in membrane and protein quality control; exact substrates are not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: FtsH
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations describe a processive ATP-dependent zinc metallopeptidase acting on cytoplasmic and membrane proteins.
Annotated as a plasma-membrane, multi-pass protein with the catalytic machinery on the cytoplasmic side.
Annotated activities include ATP binding, ATP hydrolysis, ATP-dependent peptidase activity, metalloendopeptidase activity, and zinc ion binding.
Reviewed homologs are annotated as homohexamers.
